# ZIP recovery fixtures

`zip-dotnet-NoCompression.zip` and `zip-dotnet-Optimal.zip` are generated by
`scripts/create-zip-fixtures.ps1` using .NET `System.IO.Compression.ZipArchive`.
They contain only synthetic fixed text, a Unicode entry name, repeated UTF-8
text and an empty entry. They are independent of DiskStudio's ZIP parser and
Rust test archive builder. No user files or device data are included.

Rust tests verify all entry data against ZIP CRC-32 and recover the archive
byte-for-byte into an in-memory sink. ZIP64 and streamed-descriptor variants
are separately constructed and validated in Rust; those are not independent
producer evidence. Real Office application opening and real-device recovery
remain separate acceptance work.
